notes.title: Deus Ex The Fall Patch 1.0.1 Update
notes.content:
Hey folks, 

Firstly, thanks for all your constructive feedback. I’d also like to thank you all for your patience. 
I know it’s been a while since release, but we’ve been working hard in implementing new features and tweaking some performance issues you all fed back to us at launch. 

Patch notes:

Changelog for update 1.0.1


Audio
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
5.1 & 7.1 now supported


Controls
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Custom Key binding now supported 


Stability
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Movement/V-Sync Bug now addressed


Miscellaneous 
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Missing StringID 1942 issue now rectified


That’s all for this patch.
